items.name: signature-draw
items.title: Signature Draw
items.description: A handwritten SVG signature that inks itself in on scroll, followed by an underline flourish.

items.name: reveal-cards
items.title: Reveal Cards
items.description: A grid of feature cards that fade up one after another as the grid scrolls into view.

items.name: stat-counter-row
items.title: Stat Counter Row
items.description: A row of three or four stats that count up from zero as the row scrolls into view.

items.name: sticky-feature
items.title: Sticky Feature
items.description: A pinned left panel with a progress rail while numbered steps scroll past on the right.

items.name: headline-text-reveal
items.title: Headline Text Reveal
items.description: A hero headline whose words rise into place one after another on scroll.

items.name: pinned-feature-tour
items.title: Pinned Feature Tour
items.description: A section pinned under your header while three features take turns, each with a line drawing that inks itself as the pin moves on.

items.name: horizontal-case-strip
items.title: Horizontal Case Strip
items.description: A row of case studies that scrolls sideways while the page scrolls down: a pixel of scroll moves it a pixel, with a count, a progress rail and keyboard focus that brings each card into view.

items.name: video-scrub
items.title: Video Scrub
items.description: A pinned product film scrubbed by scroll, with chapters that follow the film. Bring your own film, encoded with a keyframe every few frames.

items.name: reading-progress
items.title: Reading Progress
items.description: A thin bar at the top of the screen that fills as the reader moves through an article.
